Working notes — request routing

Options seen: A standard queue, B priority desk, C regional office; D is invalid and must not be chosen.

Evidence:
- C succeeded only for claim requests from the south region: REQ-2400 (small), REQ-2407 (large), REQ-2408 (small).
- C was rejected for non-claim requests tested: refunds from south (REQ-2401, REQ-2403) and east (REQ-2405, REQ-2409), invoices from east (REQ-2402, REQ-2406). Shipment case (REQ-2404) rejected option D.
- Therefore, C is not generally valid for refunds, invoices, or shipments.

Working rule:
- If request type = claim AND region = south, route to C.
- Otherwise, do not use C; avoid D entirely.
- A vs B for other cases remains untested. No successful A/B choice has been observed yet, so do not infer priority from size or urgency.

Signals that did NOT affect outcome:
- Small vs large amount.
- Requester name/desk.
- Subject-line phrases such as “same as last month,” “regional office,” “client asking twice,” “scanned, not typed,” “second attempt,” “no rush,” “confirm receipt.”
- East vs south region by itself, except C validity appears tied to south + claim.

Next useful tests:
- Non-claim south requests to see whether A or B should be used.
- Claim requests in east/other regions to see whether C is region-specific.
- Any A/B success/failure to establish routing for non-special cases.

Working notes — request routing

Options: A standard queue, B priority desk, C regional office; D invalid.

Confirmed:
- C works for claim + south (REQ-2400 small, REQ-2407 large, REQ-2408 small).
- A works for: refund + east (REQ-2418, small); shipment + east (REQ-2413, small); invoice + north (REQ-2416, small). These type/region combos are provisional.

Rejected:
- A rejected for refund + south (REQ-2410) and refund + north (REQ-2411, 2415, 2419, incl. large); claim + north/east (REQ-2412, 2414); shipment + south (REQ-2417). So A is not generally valid for refunds, claims, or south shipments.
- C not valid for non-claim requests: refunds/invoices south/east, shipments; D invalid.

Working rules:
- claim + south -> C.
- refund + east -> A (tentative).
- shipment + east -> A (tentative).
- invoice + north -> A (tentative; not enough to generalize).
- Otherwise A may fail. B remains untested. Do not infer from small/large, requester, urgency, or subject phrases.

No-effect signals: size, requester name/desk, subject phrases such as “second attempt,” “same as last month,” “regional office,” “scanned, not typed,” “no rush,” “confirm receipt,” “client asking twice.”

Caveat: operations memo says claim-request procedure changes soon; re-test claim routing.

Next tests:
- Try B where A was rejected: refund north/south, claim north/east, shipment south.
- Test non-claim south for A vs B; claim east/north for C vs B.
- Confirm A rules for invoice outside north and refund/shipment outside east.
- Re-check C claim+south before procedure change.

Working notes — request routing

Options: A standard queue, B priority desk, C regional office; D invalid.

Confirmed/current:
- claim + south -> C (REQ-2400, 2407, 2408; re-check before ops change).
- shipment + east -> A (REQ-2413, 2422). Caveat: ops memo says shipment procedure changes soon; re-test after change.
- invoice + north -> A (REQ-2416, 2426, both small).
- refund + east -> A tentative (REQ-2418).

Rejected:
- A rejected: refund south/north (2410, 2411, 2415, 2419); claim north/east (2412, 2414); shipment south (2417).
- B rejected: refund north (2420); invoice south (2423); claim north (2424); shipment north/south (2421, 2425, 2427, 2428, 2429).
- C invalid for non-claim requests; D invalid.

Rules:
- claim + south -> C.
- shipment + east -> A for now.
- invoice + north -> A.
- refund + east -> A tentative.
- B not shown valid for any tested combo; do not infer from size, requester/desk, urgency, or subject phrases.
- Otherwise A may fail.

No-effect signals: size, requester name/desk, subject phrases such as “second attempt,” “same as last month,” “regional office,” “scanned, not typed,” “no rush,” “confirm receipt,” “client asking twice,” “let me know if anything is missing.”

Next tests:
- A vs B for shipment north/south, refund south/north, claim east/north, invoice south/east.
- Confirm A rules for invoice outside north and refund/shipment outside east.
- Re-check C claim+south and shipment routing before/after procedure change.

Working notes — request routing

Options: A standard queue, B priority desk, C regional office, D invalid.

Still useful:
- refund + east -> A confirmed (REQ-2418 tentative; REQ-2438 accepted).
- invoice + north -> A (REQ-2416, 2426). Not general invoice: invoice + south A rejected (REQ-2434).
- claim + south -> C was previously confirmed (REQ-2400, 2407, 2408), but REQ-2433 (large, “second attempt”) rejected C. Treat old rule as stale/conditional; re-test.

Shipment procedure change:
- Ops memo says shipment routing changes soon.
- Old shipment + east -> A (REQ-2413, 2422) contradicted by REQ-2435: A rejected.
- Shipment + north A rejected twice (REQ-2431, 2439).
- Do not trust old shipment rules. Re-test A/B for all shipment regions after change.

New rejections:
- C rejected/invalid: non-claim; also claim east (2430), north (2436), south (2433).
- A rejected: shipment north/east/south; invoice south; refund south/north; claim north/east.
- B rejected: refund south/north; invoice south; claim north; shipment north/south. B still has no valid observed combo.
- Refund + south unresolved: A and B rejected (2410, 2415, 2432, 2437); C likely invalid as non-claim.

No-effect signals: size, requester name/desk, subject phrases such as “second attempt,” “same as last month,” “regional office,” “scanned, not typed,” “no rush,” “confirm receipt,” “client asking twice,” “let me know if anything is missing.” Do not infer routing from them.

Next tests:
- Re-check claim + south C; determine if old successes are stale.
- After ops change: A vs B for shipment east/north/south.
- Invoice outside north; refund outside east; claim east/north; refund south/north.
- Confirm whether C is ever valid for claim+south now.

Working notes — request routing
Options: A standard, B priority, C regional, D. D is not universally invalid.

Confirmed:
- refund + east -> A (2438; 2418 tentative).
- invoice + north -> A (2416, 2426, 2448). invoice + east A rejected (2442); invoice + south A rejected (2434).
- claim + south -> B accepted (2449). Old C successes stale; C rejected (2433).
- claim + north -> D accepted (2444). Prior A/B/C rejected; C 2436.
- claim + east: A/B/C rejected (B 2440, C 2430). No valid observed.

Rejections:
- refund + north: A/B/D rejected (2437, 2447). C likely invalid non-claim.
- refund + south: A/B rejected (2410, 2415, 2432, 2437); C likely invalid. Unresolved.
- shipment east: A/B rejected (2435, 2443).
- shipment north: A/B/D rejected (2431, 2439, 2445).
- shipment south: A/B/D rejected (2446). C likely invalid non-claim.
- D rejected refund+north, shipment+north/south.

Ops memo: procedure change affecting claim requests soon. Re-test claims after change; do not rely on old claim routes. Earlier shipment-change note is not supported by new memo; treat shipment rules as current unless a new shipment memo appears.

No-effect: size, requester/desk, phrases “second attempt,” “same as last month,” “regional office,” “scanned, not typed,” “no rush,” “confirm receipt,” “client asking twice,” “let me know if anything is missing.”

Next tests:
- After claim change: claim all regions, incl. east/north/south, A/B/C/D.
- Refund south/north: find valid option; test C?
- Invoice outside north.
- Shipment: re-test A/B/C only if shipment memo appears; else avoid old A+east.
- Determine if C ever valid non-claim; D only claim+north?

Working notes — request routing

Confirmed:
- Refund: east -> A (2438); north -> C (2456); south -> D (2455). Correct old note: C is valid for refund+north, so “C invalid non-claim” is wrong.
- Invoice: north -> A (2416, 2426, 2448). east -> one accepted (2452, option unrecorded); A rejected (2442), C rejected (2453). south -> A rejected (2434), C rejected (2457, 2458).
- Shipment: east -> C accepted (2454). Old A/B rejected. New ops memo: shipment procedure change soon; re-test shipments after change; do not assume old shipment rules.
- Claim: procedure change affects claims. Old claim+north D accepted is stale: claim+north D rejected (2450, 2459); claim+east D rejected (2451), and earlier A/B/C rejected. No reliable valid claim route post-change.

Rejections/corrections:
- D invalid for claim north/east post-change. D valid for refund+south.
- C valid for refund+north and shipment+east, so C is not universally invalid non-claim.
- Refund+north: A/B/D rejected; C accepted. Refund+south: A/B rejected; D accepted.
- Invoice+south C rejected; invoice+east C rejected. Shipment north/south: A/B/D rejected; C status for north/south unclear—re-test after memo.
- D rejected refund+north, shipment+north/south.

No-effect: size, requester/desk, “second attempt,” “same as last month,” “regional office,” “scanned, not typed,” “no rush,” “confirm receipt,” “client asking twice,” “let me know if anything is missing.”

Next tests:
- Claims all regions, A/B/C/D post-change.
- Invoice east: find accepted option. Invoice south: find valid option.
- Shipment after memo: all regions A/B/C/D, especially east.
- Refund north/south confirm; probe other refund regions if needed.
